layers.name: Evidex Evidence Pack
layers.one_liner: Send the evidence mess. Get back a review-ready donor, audit, or compliance pack.
layers.primary_buyer: NGO operators, grant consultants, M&E teams, and small compliance teams
layers.pain: Reporting evidence is scattered across emails, attachments, spreadsheets, and old folders.
layers.promise: A structured evidence table, source pack, narrative, quality report, invoice, and delivery ZIP.
layers.proof_asset: Golden Evidex pack plus the VAMP immutable objective-ID provenance handoff
layers.cta: Send one non-sensitive evidence folder for a pilot pack.
layers.risk_boundary: Review-ready, not automatically final. Client and operator approval required before delivery.
layers.video_hook: Your donor report is not missing effort. It is missing an evidence pipeline.
layers.visual_metaphor: messy files becoming a clean evidence table and ZIP

layers.name: HOMS Academic Production Desk
layers.one_liner: Send the batch, rubric, memo, exam brief, or assessment need. Get grade-aware academic production support back.
layers.primary_buyer: Lecturers, teachers, markers, tutors, and academic departments
layers.pain: Marking backlogs, exam setup, memoranda, and grade-appropriate assessment design drain teacher time.
layers.promise: Draft feedback, gradebook support, exam papers, memoranda, subject profiles, grade-level constraints, and educator review summaries.
layers.proof_asset: HOMS marking proof, HyMark Exam Studio proof, and Grade 1-12 matrix preview
layers.cta: Send one non-sensitive batch or assessment brief to prove the route.
layers.risk_boundary: Educator approves final marks and feedback. AI never becomes the final assessor.
layers.video_hook: What if your marking backlog, exam paper, and memo arrived as a review-ready education pack?
layers.visual_metaphor: rubric, learner work, and grade profile becoming an educator review desk

layers.name: HOMS Learning Studio
layers.one_liner: Turn one curriculum topic into a connected guide, activity, worksheet, assessment, memo, and optional video lesson.
layers.primary_buyer: Schools, tutors, extra-class providers, education publishers, and subject departments
layers.pain: Learners receive disconnected notes, worksheets, assessments, and videos that do not follow one curriculum spine.
layers.promise: A grade-, term-, topic-, and cognitive-level-aware companion pack whose teaching material and assessment test the same intended knowledge.
layers.proof_asset: Grade 10 Physical Sciences Term 3 Motion in One Dimension pack: guide, practical, worksheet, mini-assessment, memoranda, eight visual assets, captioned video and validation receipt
layers.cta: Nominate one grade, term, subject, and topic for a controlled companion-pack pilot.
layers.risk_boundary: Golden review candidate generated. A subject expert must still approve curriculum fit, answers, sources, rights, and classroom release before commercial claims or learner use.
layers.video_hook: What if the lesson, worksheet, activity, assessment, and memo all came from the same curriculum spine?
layers.visual_metaphor: one topic branching into a coherent guide, worksheet, assessment, memo, and video lesson

layers.name: KnowEdge Inbox Desk
layers.one_liner: Turn Outlook into a controlled workflow queue with drafts, risk flags, and evidence notes.
layers.primary_buyer: Busy academics, administrators, consultants, and small business owners
layers.pain: The inbox hides work, risk, deadlines, and evidence inside an endless message list.
layers.promise: Urgency/risk routing, reply drafts, evidence notes, and job creation for downstream workflows.
layers.cta: Export a small inbox sample and see what routes into useful work.
layers.risk_boundary: Draft-only. No automatic sending, deleting, moving, or calendar creation.
layers.video_hook: Your inbox is not a to-do list. It is an intake system waiting to be routed.
layers.visual_metaphor: emails becoming product jobs and approval cards

layers.name: VAMP Performance Evidence Desk
layers.one_liner: Stop hunting performance evidence at review time.
layers.primary_buyer: Academic staff, HR administrators, department heads, and performance review coordinators
layers.pain: Performance agreements and evidence live in separate files, email threads, and forgotten folders.
layers.promise: Profile-driven objective mapping, calibrated evidence candidates, duplicate suppression, declarations, gaps, and an Evidex-backed review snapshot.
layers.proof_asset: VAMP-COMMERCIAL-PRIVATE-001: 190 records, 116 accepted mappings, 24 review candidates, and 63.9% evidence-backed objective coverage
layers.cta: Send a task agreement and one month of evidence for a pilot snapshot.
layers.risk_boundary: Evidence preparation only. No automatic rating or employment decision; an authorised human approves interpretations and release.
layers.video_hook: Annual review panic starts because evidence was never collected as evidence.
layers.visual_metaphor: task agreement rows lighting up as evidence gets mapped

layers.name: Sophia Academic Review Desk
layers.one_liner: Academic review support without ghostwriting or replacing authorship.
layers.primary_buyer: Postgraduate students, supervisors, writing centres, and research groups
layers.pain: Students need high-level feedback on argument, sources, referencing, and structure without crossing integrity lines.
layers.promise: A literature discovery map, technical citation audit, claim-to-source ledger, anchored reviewer commentary, and human approval receipt.
layers.cta: Request one review of a manuscript section up to 5,000 words.
layers.risk_boundary: No ghostwriting, no fabricated citations, no authorship replacement.
layers.video_hook: The safest academic AI is not the one that writes for you. It is the one that shows you what to fix.
layers.visual_metaphor: chapter draft becoming argument, evidence, and citation review lanes

layers.name: DIO Document Studio
layers.one_liner: Turn an authorised document into a clean technical edit, visible redline, controlled glossary, and human-reviewed translation pack.
layers.primary_buyer: SMEs, NGOs, universities, consultancies, municipalities, training providers, and professional-services teams
layers.pain: Important reports, procedures, policies, manuals, and communications are unclear, inconsistent, or inaccessible across languages.
layers.promise: A clean copy, paragraph-level redline, change ledger, translated clean copy, bilingual review copy, terminology glossary, QA report, and approval receipt.
layers.proof_asset: English-to-Afrikaans golden review candidate plus isiZulu, Sesotho, and Setswana configured proof candidates
layers.cta: Submit the scope, word count, language pair, audience, and terminology requirements for one authorised document.
layers.risk_boundary: Not certified, sworn, legal, or automatically final. Technical meaning, target-language quality, layout, and client release require appropriate human approval.
layers.lead_magnet: Technical Document Readiness and Translation Brief
layers.video_hook: A fast translation is useless if one wrong verb changes the instruction. Make every correction inspectable.
layers.visual_metaphor: one source document becoming a clean copy, visible redline, glossary, and bilingual review
